thread:
Lina: heads-up — onboarding sampleapp created by growth team is seeing duplicated invoices when a long generate call hits a 429 during auth rotation. repeating for both node and go SDKs.

Omar: ugh. any logs/sample? does it look like a pure retry or a partial success + replay?

Lina: looks like partial success on server side (webhook emitted) then client retried after 429 and webhook fired again. no Idempotency header in requests. repro steps in thread.

Priya: are we ignoring Retry-After? if server sends it clients should back off. also: many SDKs differ on default jitter algorithm — parity bug?

Lina: server returned 429 with Retry-After: 0.8 (seconds) in some runs, but client retried immediately because their backoff used integer seconds and rounded down to 0.

Omar: oh that's a nasty edge. SDK should parse Retry-After float values, clamp minimum to 100ms, and apply jitter. Also respect Cache-Control / RateLimit headers where present.

Priya: propose quick fixes:
- SDK: parse Retry-After as float, clamp to minBackoff=100ms
- Use full jitter: delay = randomBetween(0, base*2^attempt)
- Default attempts=4, opt-out via config
- Auto-add X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key per logical op for HTTP flows

Lina: sounds good. For streaming we can't always avoid side-effects; maybe replay-guard token header (X-Redwood-Replay-Guard) that server uses to decide safe replay if no side-effects were emitted yet.

Omar: agreed. Also need parity note: Node, Go, Python SDKs must behave the same for these edgecases. Add unit tests that simulate fractional Retry-After and token rotate mid-request.

Priya: sketch of backoff (full jitter):
```js
function backoffMs(attempt, baseMs=200) {
  const cap = 20000;
  const raw = Math.min(cap, baseMs * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * raw);
}
// respect Retry-After header if present: delay = max(parsedRetryAfter*1000, backoffMs(attempt))
```

Lina: also found onboarding UX issue: sampleapp example uses simple fetch retry with no idempotency in README. we should update quickstart to show idempotency + Retry-After handling by default.

DevX Bot: New docs draft: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries#quickstart-parity (WIP). Also raised issue RD-8421 to add fractional Retry-After parsing to all SDKs.

qa-bot: reproduced on staging with load generator. spikes happen when token rotate and routing flips instance. Duplicate webhook rate ~0.8% without idempotency, ~0% with idempotency. Test artifacts: https://ci.redwood/reports/8421

Omar: thanks @qa-bot. next steps: 1) patch SDKs to parse Retry-After float + clamp 2) enable idempotency_header generation for HTTP calls 3) add X-Redwood-Replay-Guard for streaming opt-in 4) update sampleapp README + quickstart 5) add unit/integration tests simulating token-rotation race

Priya: I'll take Go + Python patches, @Omar take Node? Lina can update sampleapp README.

Lina: on it. I'll push a tiny PR adding idempotency and a short note about honoring Retry-After fractional seconds.

deploy-bot: start_deploy: staging/sampleapp @1758000028 :rocket:

Lina: will post results after the staging run. thanks all :heart:
